stem:
Priya fixes four wax pins, P, Q, R and S, at equal gaps along a copper strip in her school laboratory. Pin P is nearest to the flame and pin S is farthest from it. She heats one end of the strip with a spirit lamp.

In which order do the pins fall from the strip?

options.text: All four pins fall at the same time.
S falls first, then R, then Q, then P.
P falls first, then Q, then R, then S.
Only P falls; Q, R and S stay attached.

teacher.key_rationale: Heat travels along the metal strip by conduction from the hot end toward the colder end, so the wax nearest the flame melts first. The pins therefore drop in order P, Q, R, S — option C. Option A drops the condition that conduction takes time along the strip; option B reverses the direction of heat flow; option D wrongly limits heating to the nearest pin.
